description: Source code for the TransactionDeletionRecord doctype in ERPNext, including class methods for data cleanup and deletion related to transactions, companies, and linked documents.

classes.name: TransactionDeletionRecord
classes.description: Main class handling transaction deletion and cleanup operations within ERPNext.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates user permission and calls validation for doctypes to be ignored.

methods.name: validate_doctypes_to_be_ignored
methods.description: Ensures only allowed doctypes are manually added to the ignored list.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations before submitting the record.

methods.name: populate_doctypes_to_be_ignored_table
methods.description: Populates the ignored doctypes table with default values.

methods.name: delete_bins
methods.description: Deletes stock bins related to the company's warehouses.

methods.name: delete_lead_addresses
methods.description: Deletes addresses linked to leads of the company.

methods.name: reset_company_values
methods.description: Resets sales data for the company.

methods.name: delete_company_transactions
methods.description: Deletes transactions and related data linked to the company across various doctypes.

methods.name: get_doctypes_to_be_ignored_list
methods.description: Returns a list of doctypes to be ignored during deletion.

methods.name: get_doctypes_with_company_field
methods.description: Fetches doctypes that have a link to the Company doctype.

methods.name: get_number_of_docs_linked_with_specified_company
methods.description: Counts documents linked to the company in a specific doctype.

methods.name: populate_doctypes_table
methods.description: Adds doctype info to the internal table if not already present.

methods.name: delete_child_tables
methods.description: Deletes child table records linked to the company's parent documents.

methods.name: delete_docs_linked_with_specified_company
methods.description: Deletes documents in a doctype linked to the company.

methods.name: update_naming_series
methods.description: Resets the naming series counter for a doctype.

methods.name: delete_version_log
methods.description: Deletes version logs related to the doctype and company.

methods.name: delete_communications
methods.description: Deletes communication records linked to the doctype and company.
